title: Infineon and SolarEdge Expand Partnership on Solid-State Circuit Breakers for 800V DC
excerpt: On September 9, 2026, Infineon and SolarEdge announced an expanded partnership on solid-state circuit breakers to protect 800V DC power distribution in AI data centers. We explain the role of SiC JFETs, why interrupting DC is hard, and the performance and production timing that remain unconfirmed at the development stage.
